# FDG7052

> DO throw `FormatException` to indicate the input string in a text parsing method does not conform to the required, or specified, format.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.10 FormatException.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a method parses text, and why it fails, is judgment.
